description: SHOW FUNCTIONS lists the whole dispatchable library: built-ins beside user functions, the 14 window functions, the higher-order three, dispatch aliases (each really dispatching under its own name), operator-implemented names (||, [], IS NULL, COUNT(*), ...), SYSTEM$ functions; description defaults to the user-defined placeholder or carries the routine's comment; and the non-registry families really dispatch. Converted from ddl/ShowFunctionsTest (9 of its 11 tests; the two engine-internal ones - the registry-equality sweep and the every-name-resolves loop - stay in the trimmed Java class). DIV-absence and the SYSTEM$TYPEOF/STREAM_HAS_DATA listings are engine-only facts split into skip-snowflake tests, as the Java's assumptions gated them.

steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER("name")) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") IN ('UPPER', 'ABS', 'SUM')
CREATE FUNCTION my_udf(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'x + 1'
SELECT MAX(IFF(UPPER("name") = 'MY_UDF', "is_builtin", NULL)), COUNT_IF("is_builtin" = 'Y') > 0 FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER("name")) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") IN ('ROW_NUMBER', 'RANK', 'DENSE_RANK', 'LAG', 'LEAD', 'FIRST_VALUE', 'LAST_VALUE', 'NTH_VALUE', 'NTILE', 'PERCENT_RANK', 'CUME_DIST', 'RATIO_TO_REPORT', 'CONDITIONAL_TRUE_EVENT', 'CONDITIONAL_CHANGE_EVENT')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER("name")) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") IN ('TRANSFORM', 'FILTER', 'REDUCE')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER("name")) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") IN ('SUBSTR', 'ARRAYAGG', 'RLIKE', 'DAYOFMONTH', 'BIT_OR_AGG', 'REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL', 'APPROXIMATE_COUNT_DISTINCT')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "name") FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" IN ('LIKE_ANY', 'LIKE_ALL', 'ILIKE_ANY', '||', '[]', ':', 'IS NULL', 'IS NOT NULL', 'COUNT(*)', 'BETWEEN', 'CASE', 'REGEXP')

skip.reason: a real account lists DIV even though it cannot run it (Java test had the same assumption); this engine's listing mirrors what it dispatches

steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER("name")) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") IN ('SYSTEM$WAIT', 'SYSTEM$SET_RETURN_VALUE')

skip.reason: a real account omits SYSTEM$TYPEOF and SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA from its own listing (Java test had the same assumption); this engine dispatches both

steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER("name")) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE UPPER("name") IN ('SYSTEM$TYPEOF', 'SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA')
CREATE FUNCTION d_plain(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS 'x + 1'
CREATE FUNCTION d_commented(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER COMMENT = 'my fn comment' AS 'x + 2'
CREATE PROCEDURE d_proc() RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS BEGIN RETURN 'a'; END
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a) AS R FROM dispatch_rows
SELECT TRANSFORM(ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(1, 2), x -> x * 2)[1]::INTEGER AS T
